strategy: one-time outdoor Horde full-clear baseline; structural exclusions only; no pre-run economic pruning

entry_contract.planned_transition: 加弗洛克 → 欧尼瓦营地 → 系统飞行到征服堡 → 陆路越境进入嚎风峡湾西侧药剂师营地

dependency_rows.name: 找到先知拉瑞恩·迷雾行者
卡玛古的长者阿图伊克
格雷兹克斯·斯宾德斯纳普

tasks.name: 新的药剂
tasks.objective_text_zh: 复仇港的药剂师雷杉德尔要求你从东南边的沉船残骸附近回收10个完整的药剂容器。
tasks.objective_text_en: Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing wants you to recover 10 Intact Plague Containers from the wrecked ship to the southeast.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 强化毒素
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从巨型潮行蟹身上获取3个巨型毒腺，把它们交给复仇港的药剂师雷杉德尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 3 Giant Toxin Glands from Giant Tidecrawlers to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 海中测试
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与蝙蝠管理员卡米蕾交谈，骑乘蝙蝠前去拦截联盟的增援部队。飞到联盟舰队上空时，使用药剂瓶拦截他们并统计16份测试结果。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Bat Handler Camille and take a riding bat to intercept the Alliance reinforcements. Once above their fleet, use the Plague Vials to infect 16 North Fleet reservists.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 问题的根源
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死斯克尔德·达拉克森和5名掠龙训练者，完成任务后向灰烬龙巢中的灰烬龙巢古树复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 5 Dragonflayer Handlers and Skeld Drakeson. If you manage to do so, return to an Ember Clutch Ancient in the Ember Clutch.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 战况报告
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往复仇港南方的鲜血谷，与战场上的黑暗游侠莉安娜和死亡猎手拉扎尔谈一谈。完成任务后向高级执行官安希尔姆复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathstalker Razael in the battlefield at the Bleeding Vale south of Vengeance Landing. Return to High Executor Anselm when you've completed this task.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 让它们吃乌鸦
tasks.objective_text_zh: 复仇港的猎犬管理员伯提乌斯要求你使用瘟疫犬笼召唤一只饥饿的瘟疫犬，并用复仇港西边那些峡湾乌鸦的肉将它喂饱。
tasks.objective_text_en: Pontius, the kennel keeper at Vengeance Landing, wants you to use the Plaguehound Cage to summon a Hungry Plaguehound and feed it Crow Meat from Fjord Crows west of Vengeance Landing.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风行者舰队
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与复仇港的蝙蝠管理员卡米蕾交谈，然后前往风行者号，向甲板上的哈克尔船长报到。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Bat Handler Camille at Vengeance Landing and obtain passage to the Windrunner. Report to Captain Harker aboard the ship.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 伏击！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 风行者号上的哈克尔船长要求你杀死15名北方舰队陆战队员。
tasks.objective_text_en: Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 指引方位
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用烟雾信号弹标记出荒弃海岸北墙外的联盟火炮位置。完成任务后向鲜血谷的黑暗游侠莉安娜复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Smoke Flares at the location of the Alliance Cannons on the northern wall of the Derelict Strand. Report to Dark Ranger Lyana at the Bleeding Vale after you've completed this task.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 致命的打击
tasks.objective_text_zh: 复仇港南方的黑暗游侠莉安娜要你潜入荒弃海岸，杀死欧斯勒上尉、塞雷尼中尉和洛瑞克中士。
tasks.objective_text_en: Dark Ranger Lyana south of the Vengeance Landing wants you to kill Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne, and Sergeant Lorric at the Derelict Strand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 向安希尔姆复命
tasks.objective_text_zh: 回到嚎风峡湾的复仇港，向高级执行官安希尔姆复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Report back to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 烈火冲天
tasks.objective_text_zh: 护送药剂师哈恩斯离开荒弃海岸。完成这个任务之后回到嚎风峡湾的复仇港，向药剂师雷杉德尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Escort Apothecary Hanes out of the Derelict Strand. Report to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord when you've completed this task.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 嗅出敌人
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在复仇港的天灾犬笼子附近使用天灾犬绳，然后在天灾猎犬的带领下仔细搜寻线索。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Plaguehound Leash near the plaguehound cages at Vengeance Landing and look for clues at the location you're led to by the Plaguehound Tracker.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 龙皮地图
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将龙皮地图交给复仇港的高级执行官安希尔姆。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Dragonskin Map to High Executor Anselm in Vengeance Landing.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进攻斯克恩！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 灰烬图腾酋长要求你前往斯克恩，在那里使用冬蹄徽章，然后与冬蹄勇士谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to use the Winterhoof Emblem at Skorn, and then to speak with the Winterhoof Brave.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 可怕而必要的手段
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬蹄营地勇士要你前往斯克恩，利用勇士的弯刀确保20个斯克恩部族的维库人无法复活。
tasks.objective_text_en: The Winterhoof Brave has asked you to use The Brave's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 燃烧吧，斯克恩，燃烧吧！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬蹄勇士建议你前往斯克恩，利用勇士的火炬烧毁东北方的长屋、西北方的长屋以及兵营。
tasks.objective_text_en: The Winterhoof Brave suggests that you use the Brave's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 危险的塔楼
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬蹄勇士要你前往斯克恩，利用勇士的烟幕弹为空袭部队标记四座塔楼的位置。
tasks.objective_text_en: The Winterhoof Brave has informed you that using the Brave's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for air strikes would be advisable.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 阻止升华！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在领主的火堆附近展开维库升华卷轴，召唤出维库领主并杀死他。完成以后，鉴于这种仪式的性质，你确信冬蹄营地里的安卡祖母会对这张卷轴感兴趣。
tasks.objective_text_en: Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension near the Thane's Pyre to call him out and slay him. Afterward, due to the nature of the ritual, you're sure that Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof will be interested in seeing the scroll.

extra_objectives.text: Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 斯克恩的征服者！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将冬蹄徽章交给冬蹄营地的灰烬图腾酋长。
tasks.objective_text_en: Return the Winterhoof Token to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 亚勒伯龙的麻烦
tasks.objective_text_zh: 灰烬图腾酋长要你杀死15个亚勒伯龙战士、8个亚勒伯龙符文法师和8个亚勒伯龙沉睡卫士，然后返回冬蹄营地向他复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to kill 15 Gjalerbron Warriors, 8 Gjalerbron Rune-casters, and 8 Gjalerbron Sleep-watchers. Afterward, return to him at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 通灵主宰麦森
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死通灵主宰麦森，然后返回冬蹄营地向灰烬图腾酋长复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 钥匙和牢笼
tasks.objective_text_zh: 安卡祖母要你去搜集足够的亚勒伯龙牢笼钥匙，用它们解救10个亚勒伯龙囚犯。完成任务后返回冬蹄营地向她复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Greatmother Ankha has asked you to collect enough Gjalerbron Cage Keys to free 10 Gjalerbron Prisoners. Return to her at Camp Winterhoof when you manage to do so.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 亚勒伯龙攻击计划
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将亚勒伯龙攻击计划交给冬蹄营地的塞莉亚·冰鬃。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Gjalerbron Attack Plans to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 冰霜巨龙和它的主人
tasks.english_name: The Frost Wyrm and its Master
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死唤龙者维尔，使用唤龙者的号角召唤并杀死格拉希恩。然后返回冬蹄营地，将号角交给塞莉亚·冰鬃。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay Wyrmcaller Vile and use the Wyrmcaller's Horn to call down and slay Glacion. Then, return with the horn to Celea Frozenmane at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 行尸走肉
tasks.objective_text_zh: 消灭10个不死的看守者、4个可怕的丧尸和2个腐烂的畸形妖，然后返回冬蹄营地向安卡祖母复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof of your success.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 地狱般的战争
tasks.objective_text_zh: 复仇港的高级执行官安希尔姆要求你到镇子的西边去，使用净化之炬净化10具尸体。
tasks.objective_text_en: High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing wants you to take the Burning Torch and use it to burn 10 of the corpses littered to the west of town.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 物资储备
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬蹄营地的安霍塔·白霜要你去收集10根斑点角鹰兽的羽毛。
tasks.objective_text_en: Ahota Whitefrost at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring him 10 clumps of Spotted Hippogryph Down.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 制作号角
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬蹄营地的诺库玛·雪眼要你将6只完整的羊角交给她。
tasks.objective_text_en: Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring her 6 Undamaged Ram Horns.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 绿色的龙卵和龙崽
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10份被感染的始祖龙崽样本交给新阿加曼德的药剂师提灵哈斯特。
tasks.objective_text_en: Plaguebringer Tillinghast has asked you to collect 10 Plagued Proto-Whelp Specimens and deliver them to him at New Agamand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 龙的胃病
tasks.objective_text_zh: 新阿加曼德的药剂师提灵哈斯特要你利用提灵哈斯特的特殊肉块吸引一头始祖幼龙，并观察它进食后的反应。
tasks.objective_text_en: Plaguebringer Tillinghast at New Agamand wants you to use Tillinghast's Plagued Meat to attract down a Proto-Drake and observe its reaction to eating the stuff.

extra_objectives.text: Place Tillinghast's Plagued Meat on the ground

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 模仿叫声
tasks.objective_text_zh: 测试雕刻过的号角，然后返回冬蹄营地向诺库玛·雪眼汇报测试结果。
tasks.objective_text_en: Test the Carved Horn and then return to Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof with the results.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 领略恐惧
tasks.objective_text_zh: 戈斯要你杀死放血者伍尔弗、恶毒的奥瑞克和贡纳·索瓦德森，并将被遗忘者旗帜插在他们面前。你需要杀死数名封锁线对面的维库人，直到他们露面。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gorth wants you to kill Ulf the Bloodletter, Oric the Baleful and Gunnar Thorvardsson and drive the Forsaken Banner through their corpses. Slay Vrykul across the Forsaken blockade until they appear.

extra_objectives.text: Slay Vrykul across the Forsaken blockade until they appear

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 血战拜尔海姆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 戈斯中士要你前往拜尔海姆，杀死16名斯克恩维库人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sergeant Gorth wants you to kill 16 Winterskorn Vrykul inside Baleheim.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 拜尔海姆在燃烧！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 戈斯中士要你前往拜尔海姆，使用戈斯的火把烧毁1座斯克恩民房、1座斯克恩瞭望塔、1座斯克恩桥梁和1座斯克恩兵营。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sergeant Gorth wants you to go to Baleheim and use Gorth's Torch to burn 1 Winterskorn Dwelling, 1 Winterskorn Watchtower, 1 Winterskorn Bridge and 1 Winterskorn Barracks.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 钢铁之门的古器
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10件钢铁之门古器交给嚎风峡湾钢铁之门的先知拉瑞恩·迷雾行者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Sage Mistwalker has asked you to collect 10 Steel Gate Artifacts. When you have all of them, return to him at Steel Gate.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 找到先知拉瑞恩·迷雾行者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 安卡祖母要你去寻找先知拉瑞恩·迷雾行者的下落。他应该在嚎风峡湾的钢铁之门附近。
tasks.objective_text_en: Greatmother Ankha has asked you to check on the condition of Sage Mistwalker. She believes him to be at or near Steel Gate.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 开始进攻
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与复仇港西边升降机旁的哨站内的戈斯中士谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Sergeant Gorth at the blockade near the elevator west of Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 裂木森林的囚犯
tasks.objective_text_zh: 远行者斯图卡·天云要你去营救7名冬蹄远行者，完成任务后钢铁之门向他复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Longrunner Skycloud has asked you to free his 7 Winterhoof Longrunners. Once you have managed to do so, return to him at Steel Gate.

extra_objectives.text: Break Riven Widow Cocoons to free captives

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 留神不速之客
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与药剂师营地的药剂师玛尔苏斯谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Apothecary Malthus at the Apothecary Camp.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 酒里有什么？
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将5只矮人酒桶交给药剂师营地的药剂师玛尔苏斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Apothecary Malthus at the Apothecary Camp wants you to bring him 5 Dwarven Kegs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 疯狂的研究
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将12份疯狂探险者的“样本”交给药剂师营地的药剂师葛瑞克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Apothecary Grick at the Apothecary Camp wants you to bring him 12 Deranged Explorer Brains.

extra_objectives.text: Use Grick's Bonesaw on corpses of Deranged Explorers

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 伏击
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往林德尔的伏击点，与林德尔谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Lydell at Lydell's Ambush.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 新阿加曼德
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往嚎风峡湾西部的新阿加曼德，将雷杉德尔的菌株交给首席药剂师哈瑞斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Lysander's Strain to Chief Plaguebringer Harris in New Agamand in western Howling Fjord.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 量身订制
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往托尔瓦德的营地，从托尔瓦德身上取得掠龙族长的样本，将它交给新阿加曼德的首席药剂师哈瑞斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Obtain the Dragonflayer Patriarch's Blood from Thorvald at Thorvald's Camp and bring it to Chief Plaguebringer Harris in New Agamand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 加热搅拌
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在大锅旁装满药剂师的空瓶，然后在其中混入哈瑞斯的药剂样本，最终调制出一瓶均衡的溶液。 /  / 完成调制任务后向首席药剂师哈瑞斯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Fill the Empty Apothecary's Flask at the Cauldron of Vrykul Blood, then mix the Flask of Vrykul Blood with Harris's Plague Samples nearby until you've obtained a Balanced Concoction. /  / Return to Chief Plaguebringer Harris when you've completed this task.

extra_objectives.text: Fill the Empty Apothecary's Flask at the Cauldron of Vrykul Blood
Mix the Flask of Vrykul Blood with Harris's Plague Samples

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 药剂喷雾
tasks.objective_text_zh: 潜入哈尔格林德，找到10名被感染的掠龙维库人并使用药剂喷雾。
tasks.objective_text_en: Venture into Halgrind and use the Plague Spray on 10 Plagued Dragonflayer Vrykul. Return to Chief Plaguebringer Harris to report the results.

sources.name: 被感染的掠龙部族成员
被感染的掠龙符文法师

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 清理实验场
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与新阿加曼德的“钢锯”杰妮谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to "Hacksaw" Jenny in New Agamand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 重要零件
tasks.objective_text_zh: 新阿加曼德的“钢锯”杰妮要求你收集6条铲齿鹿筋，再从旅行商安东那里购买一磅鲜肉，然后把这些东西带回去交给她。
tasks.objective_text_en: "Hacksaw" Jenny in New Agamand wants you to obtain 6 Shoveltusk Ligaments and 1 Fresh Pound of Flesh.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 安息
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在盾牌岭那些被掠夺过的墓穴处使用维库圣物，将伊斯多弗的冰冷之心、古神之盾、风暴愤怒法杖和克瓦迪尔上古甲胄放回它们原本的位置。 /  / 完成任务之后回到上古升降梯，向卡玛古的奥弗斯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Bundle of Vrykul Artifacts at the ransacked burial mounds of Shield Hill to return the Frozen Heart of Isuldof, the Shield of the Aesirites, the Staff of Storm's Fury and the Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir. /  / Return to Orfus of Kamagua at the Ancient Lift should you succeed.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 返回阿图伊克身边
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将坏消息传达给卡玛古的长者阿图伊克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the bad news to Elder Atuik at Kamagua.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 给它一个名字
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向新阿加曼德的托比亚斯·萨克霍夫出示你的凋零药剂样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Show the Blight Specimen to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 骂阵
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在拜尔海姆对布约恩·哈古德森朗读维库人的脏话，然后把他引到林德尔的伏击点，帮助林德尔杀了他。
tasks.objective_text_en: Read the Vrykul Insult to Bjorn Halgurdsson in Baleheim, then lead him back to Lydell's Ambush and help slay him.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进攻尼弗莱瓦
tasks.objective_text_zh: 游侠队长艾蕾尔要你前往尼弗莱瓦，杀死5名掠龙战士、4名掠龙符文法师和4条掠龙猎犬。
tasks.objective_text_en: Ranger Captain Areiel wants you to go to Nifflevar and slay 5 Dragonflayer Warriors, 4 Dragonflayer Rune-Seers and 4 Dragonflayer Hunting Hounds.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 增援冬蹄营地
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与冬蹄营地的灰烬图腾酋长谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80
